body: Doesn't that come "for free" normally if the shortcuts are registered on the buttons? Sounds like the shortcuts in the AnimationPlayer editor aren't tied to buttons currently?

Indeed, they don't make use of the Button shortcut system so that the shortcuts can be handled "globally" and work even if the dock isn't focused. Therefore, we have to set the tooltip manually.

Perhaps we should make it possible for button shortcuts to work in a more global manner, but this should be tracked in its own proposal. This way, the tooltip could still be set automatically.
